context.title: Sunrise Movement — November 3, 2026 California general election endorsements (California picks only)

subject.title: US House of Representatives, California District 7

positions.statement: "We Proudly Endorse Mai Vang" — "As an educator, organizer, and Sacramento City Councilmember, Mai Vang has shown what it looks like to fight for working families, immigrant communities, and young people, not corporate donors and lobbyists."
